subject: QuickCart — P3 modelpack rollout: throughput collapse & error spike
messages:
From: Meera Shah <meera@quickcart.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: eng+prod@quickcart.com; ethan@quickcart.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: P3 rollout — sudden throughput collapse and 500s

Hi Ava,

We pushed the P3 modelpack + p3-int8 quant profile to production at 07:45 PT via the API bundle you recommended. Within 10 minutes we saw median latency double and overall throughput drop by ~60%. Error rates (5xx) climbed from ~0.2% to 4.8% across our hot endpoints. Attaching a small sample of logs and a CSV of telemetry slices.

This is blocking our checkout path. Can you advise immediate rollback options? Our SREs are standing by for guidance — we need an urgent fix or fallback.

Thanks,
Meera
Meera Shah
Director of Engineering, QuickCart
Attachments: quickcart-prod-sample.log (text), p3-telemetry-snapshot.csv (csv)
From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: Meera Shah <meera@quickcart.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: P3 rollout — sudden throughput collapse and 500s

Meera — sorry to hear this. We're pulling the traces now. Two immediate options: 1) roll back to the prior modelpack (M2) which is instant and safe, or 2) switch QuickCart routing to the Dedicated p2 pool (higher throughput) while we debug.

I'll escalate to our runtime team and request a hot profiler snapshot. Can you confirm whether the spike correlates with larger sequence lengths or a change in client max_tokens? Also please share any request IDs for the 500s so we can correlate.

I'll loop in Jonas and Marissa for an exec-level standby.

— Ava Chen
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: P3 rollout — sudden throughput collapse and 500s

Team — tagging into ops. Ava, thanks. Ben, can you run a quick compare between the P3 int8 kernel selection and the M2 baseline? I want to know if the runtime chose a fallback kernel path that would serially process hot requests. Also start an emergency canary rollback if QuickCart opts for it.

Meera — we have a profiler request in-flight. If you authorize rollback, we'll do it immediately and hold on changes. If you prefer we can keep P3 live and route 20% traffic to M2 as a canary. Which do you want?

Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Reliability
From: Meera Shah <meera@quickcart.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com; ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: eng+prod@quickcart.com; ethan@quickcart.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: P3 rollout — sudden throughput collapse and 500s

Jonas — please proceed with a full rollback to M2. Our checkout KPI is critical and execs want the old behavior restored. We do not want partial canaries; roll us back and pause P3 for now. Please keep us posted on the analysis and expected ETA for P3 safe re-release.

Ethan (CTO) is on standby on this thread.

Meera
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: P3 rollout — sudden throughput collapse and 500s

Action log:
- 09:25 PT: profiler snapshot collected (attached to internal drive).
- 09:42 PT: kernel selection analysis shows 82% of P3 requests were routed to the fallback dense-gemm path on node type a100-slow (unexpected).
- 09:55 PT: we initiated automated rollback for QuickCart; full rollback completed at 10:01 PT to modelpack M2.
- 10:03 PT: throughput and error rates are trending back to baseline; M2 med latency within 5% of pre-deploy.

Attachments: redwood-profiles-20261121.zip (internal profiler bundle)

Next steps: deep root-cause — why P3 int8 selected fallback path (possible quantized weight packing mismatch for P3 architecture). Schedule cross-team postmortem with Runtime/Compilation. Also recommend holding P3 until we ship a compatibility patch.

— Ben Carter
Director, Runtime Engineering
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Meera Shah <meera@quickcart.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Follow-up & exec note: QuickCart rollback complete

Meera / Ethan —

Quick update for your execs: rollback to M2 completed at 10:01 PT; our monitoring shows service recovery and drop in 5xxs back to ~0.25%. We are opening a P3 incident ticket and will provide a remedial timeline by Monday 11/23 EOD PT.

Immediate remedial commitments from Redwood:
- Full RCA with timeline and mitigations (by Mon 11/23 EOD PT).
- Compatibility patch candidate for P3 quant profile within 5 business days.
- Customer-facing change log and recommended gating for future P-level rollouts.

Thanks for the quick coordination — we're treating this with exec priority. I will set a follow-up stand-up with your SREs for 11/22 09:00 PT if that works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
